name: Sävsjö - Forsa
description: Sävsjö to Forsa. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: Djurgårdsstugan (vatten): Official water tap on the east side of Djurgårdsstugan at the entrance. Official text says water is available daily 07:00-22:00, but turned off in winter.
notes: Official GPX and v2 API expose 470-point linework, while Naturkartan v3.2 exposes a simplified 306-point line. This is a simplification, not a route contradiction.
OSM relation 15419730 covers the broad Sävsjö-Vikskvarn corridor but starts near the Sävsjö C connector junction, missing the official first about 0.52 km from Eksjöhovgårdssjön.
Official HÖ13 pages show no closure/reroute status, but Sävsjö municipality reported Storm Dave closures/warnings in the start-area landscape on 2026-04-07.
Sources variously use Forsa badplats, Bringetofta badplats, Forsabadet and Toftabadet for the endpoint cluster.
AllTrails Vikskvarn-Sävsjö is a broader 24 km composite route, not exact HÖ13.

facilities.name: Eksjöhovgårdssjön ledentré HÖ12/HÖ13
facilities.description: Official HÖ12/HÖ13 junction and HÖ13 start near Eksjöhovgårds slottsruin. Shared endpoint with HÖ12 and start-area loop; parking/toilet should be separate records.

facilities.name: Parkeringsplats Eksjöhovgårds slottsruin
facilities.description: Official parking and rest area by Eksjöhovgårds slottsruin, with benches/tables and nearby toilet. Shared HÖ12/HÖ13 start facility; deduplicate during normalization.

facilities.name: WC vid rastplats Eksjöhovgårds slottsruin
facilities.description: Toilets at the parking/rest area beside Eksjöhovgårds slottsruin, along road 127. Shared endpoint facility; seasonal/open status not independently verified.

facilities.name: Eksjöhovgårds slottsruin
facilities.coordinateSource: Naturkartan directions point and Jönköpings läns museum nearby coordinate
facilities.description: Castle ruin on an island near the HÖ13 start and official parking cluster. Off the HÖ13 GPX and shared with HÖ12 start context.

facilities.name: Anslutning Sävsjö C - HÖ12/HÖ13
facilities.description: Official unmarked 1.4 km one-way connector between the main trail and Sävsjö station for bus/train access. Connector attaches about 0.52 km along HÖ13 from the start; it is not part of HÖ13 mainline geometry.

facilities.name: Djurgårdsstugan (vatten)
facilities.description: Official water tap on the east side of Djurgårdsstugan at the entrance. Official text says water is available daily 07:00-22:00, but turned off in winter. Apply time and winter-off caveats. The 2026-04-07 Storm Dave notice says Djurgårdsområdet is affected and visitors are advised not to use the area until cleared.

facilities.name: Parkering Djurgårdsområdet
facilities.description: Official parking with access to the nearby recreation area. Storm Dave notice says Djurgårdsområdet trails were affected and visitors were advised against using the area on 2026-04-07.

facilities.name: Skrapstad / Nybygget shelter
facilities.description: Official shelter at Skrapstad/Nybygget with room for four people and a grill/fireplace. Official text says the site lacks water. Merge the OSM firepit into this shelter record unless the app requires a separate fireplace marker. Do not import as a water source.

facilities.name: Skrapstad gravfält / RAÄ L1971:334
facilities.description: Large prehistoric grave field near Skrapstad. Older Sävsjö material names Karstorp/Skrapstad and describes the grave field and nearby Nybygget shelter. Coordinate represents heritage point/polygon centroid context, not a service facility.

facilities.name: Forsa badplats, ledentré HÖ13/HÖ14
facilities.description: Official HÖ13/HÖ14 endpoint. Official page says Forsa badplats, also called Bringetofta or Tofta, has parking, shelter, grill and bathing place; dry toilet is available 1 June-31 August. Use alias handling for Forsa badplats, Bringetofta badplats, Forsabadet and Toftabadet. Child facilities may be imported separately.

facilities.name: Rastplats Toftabadet
facilities.description: Official rest area on the north side of Toftaån with tables, grills, dry toilet, parking, bathing place, changing room and jetty. May duplicate Forsa badplats aggregate object; normalize as endpoint service cluster or dedupe child facilities.

facilities.name: Forsabadet vindskydd
facilities.coordinateSource: Smålandsleden/Naturkartan official-source lane marker; corroborated by Forsa badplats aggregate page
facilities.description: Endpoint shelter at Forsabadet/Toftabadet. Official nearby pages list shelter, grill/fireplace and bathing context. Direct public Naturkartan page was discoverable via search but current API v2 lookup was not found in this pass; keep coordinate-source note.

facilities.name: Forsa badplats toilet
facilities.coordinateSource: OpenStreetMap node 7117732235, corroborated by official/Nässjö facility text
facilities.description: Seasonal dry toilet at Forsa/Bringetofta badplats. Official source says dry toilet is available 1 June-31 August. Seasonal: 1 June-31 August. Do not present as year-round until locally verified.

facilities.name: Forsa / Toftaån parking
facilities.coordinateSource: OpenStreetMap node 7117732234, corroborated by Smålandsleden and Nässjö municipality
facilities.description: Parking at the Forsa/Bringetofta bathing-place endpoint. Nässjö municipality says there are about 10 spaces. Small rural parking area; exact capacity from Nässjö municipal page, not field verified.

facilities.name: Forsa / Bringetofta badplats
facilities.description: Bathing place at Toftaån/Forsa/Bringetofta with grass area, sandy bottom, changing room, jetty and endpoint rest facilities. Do not import stale water-quality status as current; HaV sample context should be refreshed during user-facing import.
